pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit opening secondary positions within 60 seconds of an existing entry; base position must hold at least +$3.00 unrealized profit before scaling in.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Hard Cap Loss Filter: Reject any entry where maximum calculated risk exceeds $5.00 per 0.01 lot, and enforce a 15-minute execution pause post high-impact volatility spike.
profit_harvest_threshold: Lock trailing stop to lock in 50% of unrealized gains once trade hits +$5.00 profit, letting remaining volume run toward a minimum +$15.00 target.
